name: Brute
notes: Big and slow. Gets winded after chasing for 4 seconds without swinging: it stops for 2.5 seconds and takes 50% more damage. Distances in tiles, times in ticks (20 per second).
description: Big, slow, and heavy. If it chases too long without swinging, it gets tired and needs a rest.

bestiary.tip: A winded Brute takes extra damage. Make it chase, then strike.

lore.white: Brutes were once statues that held up the Tower's roof. The shadow made them wander.
lore.yellow: These Brutes carry stones from the broken walls. They hit hard, but they tire fast.
lore.orange: The biggest Brutes guard the high halls. Keep moving, and wait for your moment.
